# Foreign model adapters

Per-model-family corrections, keyed on the HuggingFace ``model_type`` (``*`` is the default). Everything a foreign model needs is normally discovered from the loaded model and tokenizer; an entry here exists only where discovery is wrong for a specific family, so that a quirk is one registry entry instead of a branch in the forward pass.

Namespace: ``registry.namespace("model_adapters")``, declared in ``praxis.models`` (1 entries)

## `*`

The default: discover everything, correct nothing.
